anchor: // Maintenance is best-effort by construction: the next tick tries again.
fix: Append one line {at, error} to <dataDir>/auto-prune.log in the catch (best-effort, never throws). Test: spawnChild throws, the log has the line.
how: catch(() => {}) in scheduleAutoPrune; auto-prune.log only receives the CHILD's output, so a failure in the stamp write, openSync or spawn itself is invisible. Raised as CRITICAL by two reviewers in PR #81 round 2 and left out as pre-existing.
title: scheduleAutoPrune swallows every runAutoPruneOnce error, so a sweep that fails before spawning leaves no trace

fix: Only if a second daemon per data dir ever becomes possible: take an O_EXCL lock file next to last-prune.json for the read-stamp-spawn sequence.
how: Stamp read-then-write in runAutoPruneOnce is not atomic across processes. Today one daemon per machine (commands-daemon.ts:194 is the only caller). Rejected in PR #81 review for that reason, recorded in CLAUDE.md.
title: The auto-prune in-flight flag serialises one scheduler only; two daemons on one data dir can still both sweep
